subject.title: active-memory recall sub-agent gets 0 assembled messages, always times out

question: Should the still-open circuit-breaker mitigation PR https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100176 be closed as superseded by the merged recall-session repair, or rebased only if a distinct current-main timeout remains?
rationale: The direct root-cause repair is merged, but the open PR formally closes this issue and is not a clean, proof-positive replacement; only a maintainer should choose whether any residual mitigation remains worth preserving.

options.title: Close the mitigation as superseded
options.body: Recommended: treat PR 105255 as the root-cause repair and close the stale mitigation branch unless a current-main reproduction shows a separate timeout path.

options.title: Request a rebase and live repro
options.body: Keep the mitigation only if its author can rebase it and prove a recurring recall timeout still occurs independently of the SQLite session fix.

recommendation.title: Close the mitigation as superseded
recommendation.body: Recommended: treat PR 105255 as the root-cause repair and close the stale mitigation branch unless a current-main reproduction shows a separate timeout path.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and merged the current recall-session implementation that determines whether the mitigation remains necessary.
